name: phd-4plus1-credit-is-not-nd-residency
description: DGS 2026-09-13, closing a question the red-team pass raised twice and answered two ways: a 4+1's pre-entry Notre Dame coursework counts toward the Ph.D.'s 60 and 24 (F7, 2026-09-12) but NOT toward §4.2's "at least nine (9) credits at Notre Dame" — "it does not count towards the nine new credits that need to be earned at Notre Dame during the degree program". Here the 4+1 course adds 3 credits to the 24 while the nine-credit row counts only the 6 earned in the program, and the row says why. (countedToward: neither since 2026-09-22 — every Ph.D. student is asked whether the bachelor’s degree used the course, because at most 6 credits may count toward two degrees, Graduate School.)

detailIncludes: these nine are graduate credits earned at Notre Dame — in the Ph.D., or in your Notre Dame MSCSE
